description: This PHP class defines a command for dumping a Drupal database to a script, including schema and data export functionalities, specifically tailored for MySQL backend.

classes.name: DbDumpCommand
classes.description: A Drupal console command class that exports the current database schema and data into a PHP script, primarily for MySQL databases.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, and options for the dump command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the dump process, generating the database script based on input options.

methods.name: generateScript
methods.description: Creates the PHP script that contains schema and data dump for the database tables.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of database tables, excluding those matching exclude patterns.

methods.name: getTableSchema
methods.description: Generates a schema array for a specific table, tailored for MySQL.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Adds index, primary key, and unique key info to the table schema.

methods.name: getTableCollation
methods.description: Sets the character set for a table based on its collation.

methods.name: getTableData
methods.description: Fetches all data from a specified table.

methods.name: fieldTypeMap
methods.description: Maps MySQL field types to Drupal schema types.

methods.name: fieldSizeMap
methods.description: Maps MySQL field types to Drupal schema sizes.

methods.name: getFieldOrder
methods.description: Determines the order of fields for a table, primarily for primary key ordering.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Provides the PHP script template used for database dump.

methods.name: getTableScript
methods.description: Generates PHP code to create a table and insert its data.
